meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去搜索你在 cmem.ai 上的 Claude-Mem 记忆——里面是过去各会话生成的带时间戳观察记录。它先做关键词粗搜、再收窄,最后用平实语言把相关记录讲给你听,而不是直接抛出原始搜索结果。
howto.when: 当你说出 “search memory”、“check claude-mem” 等关键词,或想要某项目、决策、任务的过往会话背景时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的记录
say.note: 先粗搜再收窄,然后用平实语言作答

say.text: 上次会话我们做了什么?
say.note: 会结合时间戳给出结论

say.text: 记忆里关于这个报错有什么观察?
say.note: 会提取相关观察记录作答

howto.what_en: After install, Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai — timestamped observations from past sessions. It runs broad keyword searches, narrows them, then answers in plain language instead of dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "search memory", "check claude-mem" and similar keywords, or want prior-session context about a project, decision, or task.

say_en.text: Search my memory for notes about this project
say_en.note: Broad pass, then narrows, then answers

say_en.text: What did we do last session?
Any observations about this error in memory?
